notes.title: Faye Falling Version 1.4
notes.notes:
Faye Falling version 1.4 is out now! This update includes an important bug fix related to the PC version of Challenge Mode, as well as some new rings, a new ring shop, clearer tutorials/guidance near the start of the game and lots more! The game is also 40% off for the next two weeks!


[previewyoutube="Kq-HPECdqn4;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr]Patch NotesNew Rings
8 new rings have been added. These give battle strategies a lot more variety - especially against enemies with a 100 speed stat.

Rage Ring: When hit by an enemy with 100 speed, all your stats will buff.

Steady Ring: When hit by an enemy with 100 speed, you'll gain 3 mana.

Sturdy Ring: When hit by an enemy with 100 speed, you'll take 1 less point of damage. (If you can reduce their damage to 0, it'll count as an evade, and you'll get to counter-attack them!)

Grit Ring: If you fail evading an attack or hit by an enemy with 100 speed, you'll still counter-attack.

Spike Ring: Enemies will take another point of damage from ailments.

Focus Ring: When you evade an attack, you'll buff your attack stat.

Shield Ring: When you evade an attack, you'll buff your defense stat.

Blood Ring: When you evade an attack, you'll buff your critical stat.
Ring Placements
Changed the library puzzle reward from a Limit Fruit to a Rage Ring.

Added some of these new rings to merchants across the game.
Five's Ring Shop
After buying the Power Gauntlet, Fives will now give you access to his ring shop. He'll sell all the new rings, as well as some other important ones.

You'll be able to steal from him like other shops if you're on the Parasite gameplay path.

Moved the original Mercy trader in Five's room to the cavern's final puzzle room.

Added an NPC who mentions Fives near the 3rd target puzzle.
Bug Fixes
Fixed the new 1.3 Steam version of Challenge Mode miscounting two puzzles.

Fixed the Shop, Spell and Skill windows overlapping the scroll sound when scrolling past the top or bottom selection.

Fixed the moving targets spawning particles even when the game was paused.
Early Tutorials and Guidance
The game now guides the player a little bit more at the start of the game, without crossing the line into being too modern and hand-holdy.

Stronger Battle System Guidance

The battle tutorial now clearly says you must use the letter and arrow keys, or face buttons and the analog stick, to cast spells.

Made the direction input icons full arrows.

When a combat spell is used outside of battle, the narration now says, "You can only use healing spells outside of battle."

Stronger Chapter 2 Guidance

The dash ability receive window now mentions it can be used to break objects.

Added a lost spirit in Normal mode by the white crystals. They wonder how to break through them.

Added a hint sign near the white crystals (this might be too hand-holdy...let me know!).

The dash crystal narration now says "break through" instead of "break."

The hint sign in the glowing sword puzzle now has a marker in the GUI.

Missed dashes into the glowing swords that are still somewhat close now read as a hit.

Added a sign to the start of the Desert: Dunes area warning that stronger enemies are ahead, and that players should heal and save between them.

The Blessing key items now use condensed forms of the tutorial window descriptions.
Balancing
Players start with 3 more HP points in Normal mode to help them avoid early game overs.

Made the main save point in the Desert: Final Puzzles area a healing point.

Added two new save points that will avoid potential moderate losses of progress.

The Ability Break spell now costs 12 mana instead of 10.

Cut two forced flame battles from Chapter 3

Reduced the HP of two enemies in Chapter 2 slightly.

Adjusted some Challenge Mode evade patterns to make them more fair.
GUI
The way HP bars, etc., are drawn was changed to use sprites instead of geometric shapes. This keeps the way elements are drawn consistent across platforms and graphics cards.
Visuals
Made the border black in the sequences before and during the start of the abyss area.

Changed the jumpscare visual; it now foreshadows the ending.
Signs
Added HUD markers to direction and town signs.

Added some direction signs.
Steam Page
Updated some assets to a higher resolution.
Puzzle Walkthrough Video
I also made a complete guide to solving all 24 puzzles, which you can find here:
[previewyoutube="wU1yIAOj-74;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr]
I want to keep the Steam and console versions as close to parity as possible, so this might be the final  update - although I'll of course fix any bugs that pop up. (Just let me know if you run into any issues on the community forums.)

As far as my next project goes - I'll have some cool news soon...

Thanks for playing,

Jack

notes.title: Faye Falling Version 1.3
notes.notes:
The third major update for Faye Falling is out now! It features an expanded Challenge Mode, improved backtracking, new secrets, new rings, trial rewards, QOL updates, improved performance, the ability to equip two rings at once, and lots more!

Faye Falling is also 35% off for the next two weeks, so make sure to grab it if you haven't yet!

[previewyoutube=Kq-HPECdqn4;full][/previewyoutube]

Patch Notes
Harder, Expanded and Refreshed Challenge Mode
New Lore
 2 tablets readable only in Challenge Mode have been added [spoiler]outside the Secret Doorway in the Desert[/spoiler]. These contain previously written but unused lore.
EX Stats
 Enemies in Challenge Mode now have "-EX" appended to their name in the check window.
 The weakest enemy in each area now has a 100 speed stat.
 All enemies have an additional +2 attack stat buff.
 All enemies have an additional +1 defence stat buff.
Attack Patterns
 Enemies in each area now share attack patterns and use a random one each time.
 A pass was completed over all attack patterns to make them faster and harder.
Traders
 Reduced Max Stock by 2.
Cosmetics
 Encounter flames and coins now have hollow centers.
 Equipment item chests are now red.
Tutorials, Guidance and Bonus Chests
 Help Statues, Spirit Guides, and Small Chests are now replaced by red crosses.
 Added a Help Statue with red writing to the desert, telling players they're all alone.
 The battle tutorial window now skips.
 The game over screen no longer encourages you.
Name Entry
 Added unique questions.
 Added unique intro and outro text.
Tea Shop and Temporary Buffs
 Added a Tea Shop to one of the desert caves.
 For 100 gold, you can order one of three teas for a temporary stat buff that lasts until the end of your next battle. 
 Green Tea: Buffs Attack by 3 points
 Black Tea: Buffs Magic by 3 points
 Oolong Tea: Buffs Defense by 2 points.
 Added a Spirit Guide to the Desert settlement who recommends visiting the Tea Shop if you get stuck at a boss.

New Secrets
Omikuji
 There are now 6 omikuji hidden around the game.
 Find one to choose between increasing your Attack or Magic stat by 1 point.
Trial Rewards
 Each Trial now rewards you an additional blessing for scoring high. (The score requirement is the same as the achievements.)
 Interact with the scoreboard to receive your blessing of either increased Mana or Max HP.
Deeper Ring Strategies
Gauntlet
 Added a new key item called a "Power Gauntlet." This allows you to equip two rings at once.
 All ring abilities stack or power up. (ie. wearing two rings that recover 3 mana each will recover 6 mana, wearing two dodge rings will allow you to move faster than one, etc.)
 Added a new NPC called "Fives." They'll sell you a Power Gauntlet for 200 gold.
New Rings
 Dodge Ring: Move faster when evading attacks.
 Limit Ring: Limit Breaks do more damage.
 Revenge Ring: Counter-attacks do 50% bonus damage.
 Absorb Ring: Absorb spells heal 50% more HP.
Rebalanced and Powered Up Rings
 Malady Ring: Raised ailment chance to 80%.
 Mobility Ring: Raised immunity from immobility statuses to 100%.
 Precise Ring: Raised accuracy bonus to 50%.
Backtracking
Fast Travel
 The Travel Chain is now added to the top of the key items list, making it faster and more convenient to access.
 Two new fast travel points were added to the Cavern.
New Dialogue
 5 new alternative bits of dialogue have been added to Lost Spirits throughout the game. These make what they're saying more consistent with your current place in the story.
Continuity Error
 Fixed a continuity error in Chapter 3 with [spoiler]Dusk and the Dark Spirit[/spoiler] when backtracking.
QOL
Windows
 Your inventory window now opens to the last tab.
 Your spells window now opens to the last tab.
 The pause menu can now also be closed by pressing the menu button again.
 For every window, scrolling up past a top entry now scrolls down to the bottom, and scrolling down past the bottom entry now scrolls up to the top.
 Switching right at the last tab moves it back to the first, and switching left at the first tab moves it back to the last.
GamePads
 Window tabs can now be swapped using trigger buttons.
 The start button on Gamepads (and escape on keyboard) now also opens the pause menu.
Gameplay
 The height of coin hit boxes was slightly increased, making them a bit easier to collect.
Save Points
 Made one of the save points in the Desert Dunes area a healing save point.
 Added another save point to the cavern, to avoid a possible big loss of progress if killed in that area.
Faster Game Overs
 The game over screen now appears quickly, instead of fading in slowly.
Faster Name Entry
 Made the fading 2.5x faster.
Soundtrack
 The "With Fire (Gabriel Battle)" track has had a much-needed rewrite and remix. (It sounds way more cohesive with the rest of the music now!)
Visuals
 More cloud backgrounds and tones in the sky area.
 Improved the tail animation for the Dark Spirits in battle.
 Nicer page icons for the mysterious note, etc.
 Simplified the game over screen.
Optimization and Fixes
Memory Leaks
 Fixed dozens of memory leaks (shame, shame!).
Save Data
 Save files are no longer accessed during gameplay.
 The unlocks and settings save files are now combined.
 Some unused save data values are no longer written or read.
Typos Fixed "bought" typo in a Side Quest description.
 Fixed an extra space in a Side Quest description.
 Changed "counter attack" to "counter-attack" in the tutorial text.
Bugs
 Fixed the rain being blue for a moment on the forest silhouette.
General Optimisations
 The lighting surface no longer resizes every frame; only when there's a size change.
 Improved performance across the overworld by disabling some objects out of view.
 Optimised the input system.
 Optimised the pushing arrow tiles.
 Optimised dash crystals.

Thanks for playing! If you haven't already, make sure to leave a Steam review :-)

Like I've mentioned a few times, I have two new games I'll be announcing soon-ish. You can follow me on twitter or bluesky to see them when they're announced!

Jack

notes.title: Update 1.3 is Releasing May 22nd!
notes.notes:
Version 1.3 of Faye Falling will be released next week on the 22nd of May! You can try the beta version early by selecting the beta branch from the build options.

This update is the largest so far; it adds new equipment, a tea shop that grants temporary stat buffs, the ability to equip two rings, an expanded challenge mode, and lots more. You can see the draft of the patch notes here.

It also makes some significant changes under the hood, fixing memory leaks and making many optimisations. I am pretty confident the update is already bug-free...but naturally, fixing what already works can always be a little risky. So if you do try the beta, make sure to let me know in the comments or on the community forums if you run into any issues.

I also have two new games I'll be announcing soon. "Spin Spirits" is my big project I've been working on for a while. The other - "Her Crown of Blood" - is another little dark game like Faye that I just started recently. I'm really excited about both!

See you next week,
Jack

notes.title: Faye Falling Version 1.2
notes.notes:
The second big update for Faye Falling is out now. It expands Challenge Mode with additional bonus lore, implements Steam Screenshots, and makes several other improvements.

Patch Notes
New Content
Expanded Challenge Mode Lore
Three diaries have been added to the Challenge Mode. These offer some further insights into three of the main characters' motivations, backstory and lore. These include:
 Vesper's Diary in the Desert
 Sara's Diary in the Cavern
 Gabriel's Diary in the Sky
New Features
Steam Screenshots
 Implemented the Steam screenshot system, allowing Players to take screenshots throughout their journey.
Improved Gamepad Support
 The pause menu now opens when a gamepad is disconnected, when possible.
Improvements and Fixes
Achievements
 Rewrote and shortened some achievement names to make them clearer and less clunky.
Soundtrack
 Updated the Steam branding for the soundtrack to make it fully consistent with the game's branding.
 The soundtrack is now available on bandcamp.
Fixes
 The map design in the room after the second skill choice was tweaked to remove an unfair death from a large projectile.
 (In v1.21) Fixed "absence" typo near the end of the game. (Thanks to Wewser Lethal Dude for reporting this!)

Thanks so so much to everyone who's played so far! Make sure to leave a review if you liked the game - it really helps with Steam's algorithm.

My next game will be revealed soon, you can follow me on twitter to see it when it's announced...

Thanks, and Happy (late) New Year!
Jack

notes.title: Faye Falling Version 1.1
notes.notes:
The first major update for Faye Falling is out now. V1.1 features a detailed polish pass across the entire game, with lots of cool tweaks, adjustments and fixes.

The full patch notes are below.

Patch Notes
Bug Fixes
 Fixed arrows not firing when off screen during the Target Trial
 Fixed the footstep sound not always setting to grass in the note page rooms
 Fixed a visual bug with the wind
 Fixed the status bar closing for a moment when healing in the overworld
 Fixed flag particles being the wrong color on Final Peak
 Fixed Soul Surge not penetrating blocking spells
 Fixed overlapping heal/save sound on respawn
 Fixed the Vampiric Hex spell casting game being a bit inaccurate
 Can no longer pause when leaping down a small wall
QOL
 Added six new save points (2 to the Desert, 3 to the Cavern, and 1 to the Sky.)
 Redesigned part of the "Stairs" area in the Cavern clearer, so it's easier to traverse
 Added a resolution/performance tip on the Settings window
 Increased the max resolution by 1 scale
 Made some overworld elements, such as the dark crystals and moving pillars, clearer (especially at the start of the game)
 Slight enemy stat balance adjustments in Chapter 3 and 5 for shorter battles
 Made it easier to run from battles after less attempts
 Added a Spirit Guide right before the final boss to give some final tips
Writing
 Small adjustments to the writing of Ending 2, 3 and 4 to make them more unique and better reflect the themes of the game
 Fixed some terms not being spelt in the American form
 Fixed an extra syllable in one of the hidden haiku rooms
 Fixed "uniform" typo
 The Shadow Ring now has a clearer description
 Corrected a Soul Guild Spirit saying Soulweaves does "80 power" instead of "16 power"
Game Over Screen
 Changed "Continue" to "Reload Last Save"
 It now explains you'll be fully healed upon respawn + encourages you to not give up
 Exiting the game now fades out first
Audio
 Arrow hitting sounds now adjust their volume based on distance
 The Puzzle Success sound now plays after finishing all puzzles
Visuals
 Improved the cloud background sprites in the Sky area
 The Player character in both ending silhouttes now reflects their halo or horns
 The dark endings' credits background is now red
 The credits border is now black
Misc
 In the ending battle sequence Melee attacks now always miss + disabled Limit Breaks 
 The 3rd Numina rotates slower as they fade
 Added particles to fading lost spirits and dark spritits
 Lots of the Steam library and store graphics have been made higher resolution
 Other small tweaks and adjustments

I'll be keeping an eye out for any bugs that pop up, so make sure to report any you find over on the community forums. I'm really excited to start getting the game in front of as many people as I can.

Thanks so much to everyone who's played so far-it means so, so much to me. I really hope you enjoy my game- and look forward to my upcoming projects, big and small! :)

Jack
